description:
What if Unity Hub and GitHub Desktop had a Baby but its Adopted? Yeah..


What's new in v1.4.1
🚀 New
- Open in Terminal option in "More" Button in Project Card
- Custom HSV Color Picker
- Gitlab Repo list in Clone Repository Modal
🐛 Fixes
- Gist Pull Button not working on Onboarding Screen
- Time tracking pill moving along with play button in project card
- Play button size change no longer glitches Project card size; PR by mauriciovalentim
✨ Improvements
- Changed corner radius max value from 20 to 15
- removed squircle styled corner radius for windows (due to some visual glitches)
- Animation in Segmented component
- Update Pin Button in Pinned state on Project Card
- Remove inner scrollbar from manage categories modal
